    def get_obs(self, cameras=("head_camera", "front_camera", "left_camera", "right_camera"), seconds: float = 0.0,
                video_fps: int = 10, include_depth: bool = False, video: str = "frames") -> Result:

        meta = {"cameras": list(cameras), "seconds": float(seconds), "video_fps": int(video_fps), "include_depth": bool(include_depth), "video": video}

const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""One-shot controller for the frozen button-press-topdown episode.
+
+Uses only the task target, robot proprioception, and camera observations from
+the standard robot client.  It raises, moves over the target, then presses in
+small downward increments and leaves the last command in place.
+"""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+OUT = Path("/app/output/trajectory")
+CAMERAS = ["front", "left", "topview"]
+
+
+def action_rows(delta_m, n, grip=-1.0):
+    """Create n native ee_delta rows for a total mocap displacement in metres."""
+    row = np.zeros(4, dtype=np.float64)
+    row[:3] = np.asarray(delta_m, dtype=np.float64) / (0.01 * n)
+    row[3] = grip
+    return np.repeat(row[None, :], n, axis=0)
+
+
+def run():
+    robot = Robot()
+    spec = robot.spec()
+    dt = spec["control_dt"]
+    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True)
+    proprio = obs.meta["proprio"]
+    mocap = np.asarray(proprio["now"][4:7], dtype=np.float64)
+    goal = np.asarray(obs.meta["task"]["target_pos"], dtype=np.float64)
+
+    # Lift before crossing the table, then approach above the button.
+    hover_z = goal[2] + 0.145
+    lift = np.array([mocap[0], mocap[1], hover_z]) - mocap
+    res = robot.submit(
+        "ee_delta", action_rows(lift, 40), dt=dt,
+        cameras=CAMERAS, video="frames", note="raise above table",
+    )
+    res.save(OUT / "raise")
+
+    hover = np.array([goal[0], goal[1], hover_z])
+    res = robot.submit(
+        "ee_delta", action_rows(hover - np.array([mocap[0], mocap[1], hover_z]), 240),
+        dt=dt, cameras=CAMERAS, video="frames", note="translate above button",
+    )
+    res.save(OUT / "align")
+
+    # Keep the fingers open and lower the hand in observed 2 cm increments.
+    for i in range(5):
+        down = np.tile(np.array([0.0, 0.0, -0.1, -1.0]), (20, 1))
+        res = robot.submit(
+            "ee_delta", down, dt=dt, cameras=CAMERAS, video="frames",
+            note=f"press increment {i + 1}",
+        )
+        res.save(OUT / f"press_{i + 1}")
+
+    print("target_pos:", goal.tolist())
+    print("last tcp:", res.proprio[-1, :3].tolist())
+    print("last mocap:", res.proprio[-1, 4:7].tolist())
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    run()
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
